appDescription.message: Download audio from YouTube videos. Requires Chrome to be signed in to your YouTube account.

titleUrlInput.message: The URL of the YouTube video you want to download.

titleFormatSelect.message: Select the audio format to save.

titleQualitySelect.message: Select the audio quality. Quality selection has no effect for the wav/flac formats.

titleClearOutputDirButton.message: Clear the selected output folder and save to the Downloads folder instead.

titleBrowseButtonUnsupported.message: This browser does not support folder selection.

noticeDirectoryPickerUnsupported.message: This browser does not support folder selection, so files will be saved to the Downloads folder.

titleOutputDir.message: The selected output folder. If none is selected, the file is saved to the Downloads folder.

error_INVALID_URL.message: This is not a YouTube video URL.

error_INVALID_FORMAT.message: This audio format is not supported.

error_TASK_ALREADY_RUNNING.message: Another download is already in progress.

error_INVALID_AUDIO_QUALITY.message: This audio quality is not supported.

error_AUTH_NOT_LOGGED_IN.message: You are not signed in to YouTube. Please sign in and try again.

error_AUTH_REJECTED.message: YouTube rejected the authentication. Please sign in again.

error_VIDEO_LOGIN_REQUIRED.message: This video requires signing in to YouTube to watch.

error_VIDEO_AGE_RESTRICTED.message: This video is age-restricted and cannot be downloaded.

error_VIDEO_DRM.message: This video is protected by DRM and cannot be downloaded.

error_VIDEO_NO_AUDIO_FORMAT.message: No audio format is available for this video.

error_PLAYER_JS_UNAVAILABLE.message: Could not load the YouTube player script. This extension may need to be updated.

error_EXTRACT_NSIG_FAILED.message: Could not decode the video's signature. This extension may need to be updated.

error_NSIG_REJECTED_BY_SERVER.message: YouTube rejected the decoded signature. This extension may need to be updated.

error_STREAM_URL_EXPIRED.message: The audio stream URL has expired. Please try again.

error_SABR_SERVER_ERROR.message: YouTube's streaming server returned an error. Please try again.

error_SABR_NETWORK_UNREACHABLE.message: Could not reach YouTube's streaming server. Please check your network connection.

error_FETCH_STALLED.message: The download stalled. Please try again.

error_FETCH_TIMEOUT.message: The download timed out. Please try again.

error_PLAYER_REQUEST_FAILED.message: Could not request video information from YouTube. Please try again.

error_TAB_UNAVAILABLE.message: The YouTube tab is no longer available. Please reopen the video and try again.

error_TRANSFER_INCOMPLETE.message: The audio data transfer did not complete. Please try again.

error_TRANSFER_SEQ_GAP.message: The audio data transfer was interrupted. Please try again.

error_TRANSFER_OFFSET_MISMATCH.message: The audio data transfer became inconsistent. Please try again.

error_TRANSFER_SIZE_MISMATCH.message: The audio data transfer became inconsistent. Please try again.

error_TRANSFER_WRITE_FAILED.message: Could not write the audio data. Please try again.

error_CONVERT_UNSUPPORTED.message: This audio format is not supported for conversion.

error_CONVERT_FAILED.message: Audio conversion failed. Please try again.

error_CONVERT_STALLED.message: The conversion stalled. Please try again.

error_SAVE_PERMISSION_DENIED.message: Permission to save to the selected folder was denied.

error_SW_RESTARTED.message: The process was interrupted. Please try again.

error_OFFSCREEN_UNAVAILABLE.message: Could not prepare the background processing needed for conversion. Please try again.

error_INJECTION_FAILED.message: Could not start retrieving audio from the page. Please try again.

error_RELAY_PORT_DISCONNECTED.message: The audio transfer channel with the page was disconnected. Please try again.

error_RELAY_IDLE.message: No response was received from the page for a long time. Please try again.
